answer: Ephemeral Challenge Lattice. Each agent identity must solve a fresh, randomly generated constraint problem seeded by its own prior outputs, and the solution is checked against a lagoon of held-out test cases only the verifier sees. Answers expire in seconds and cannot be copied. Attackers pay full compute per identity per epoch with no reuse. A trellis of cross-checks links each answer to neighbors, so one false node triggers a spiral of recomputation.
